trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Advanced indexing with a list selects a subset of elements/columns; assigned source shape is broadcast-compatible with the selected destination.
trigger_condition.dtype_trigger: Source and destination tensors have different dtypes, so indexed assignment requires implicit dtype promotion.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Destination is a float64 tensor and source is a different dtype; assignment is performed via advanced list indexing such as A[:, [i]] = b.unsqueeze(-1).

bug_oracle.description: Assigning a tensor of a different dtype to a float64 tensor using an advanced list index produces incorrect values when type promotion occurs.
bug_oracle.signal: Assigned tensor values differ from the expected values after correct dtype conversion.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Vary source/destination dtype pairs and advanced list index positions to cover different type-promotion paths.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct destination tensors and source tensors with mismatched dtypes and shape-compatible broadcasting for indexed assignment.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force assignments through advanced list indexing on __setitem__ where type promotion is required.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Perform indexed assignment such as dst[:, [i]] = src.unsqueeze(-1) with mismatched dtypes; then compare against a reference cast-then-assign operation.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Build expected values by converting the source tensor to the destination dtype before assignment and applying the same index selection; report value mismatches.
